title: How is Vladimir Lenin connected to Minions?
description:
The line of Kremlin leaders, a summit, a window knock on the Oval Office, two comedians and a Paris premiere connect Vladimir Lenin to the Minions.

Vladimir Lenin → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Jerry Seinfeld → Gad Elmaleh → Minions

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Vladimir Lenin → Vladimir Putin (7 portraits, every holder): Lenin founded the Soviet state in 1917, and the line of Kremlin leaders runs to Vladimir Putin.
   Photo, Public domain / CC0 / CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lenin_in_1920_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:StalinCropped1943.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1956_Press_Photo_Communist_Party_Secretary_Nikita_S._Khrushchev_in_Moscow_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Leonid_Brezhnev,_Staatshoofden,_portretten,_Bestanddeelnr_925-6564_(cropped)(2).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GorbachevMS.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boris_Yeltsin_(3x4_cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_(2026_02_23)_(cropped).jpg
2. Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama: In 2015, Putin met President Barack Obama at the United Nations in New York.
   Photo by Пресс-служба Президента России, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_and_Barack_Obama_(2015-09-29)_01.jpg
3. Barack Obama → Jerry Seinfeld: That December, Jerry Seinfeld knocked on Obama's Oval Office window to film Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jerry_Seinfeld_knocks_on_the_Oval_Office_window.jpg
4. Jerry Seinfeld → Gad Elmaleh: In 2017, Seinfeld shared a Montreal stage with his friend, French comedian Gad Elmaleh.
   Photo by Susan Moss / brioux.tv, Fair use (commentary): https://brioux.tv/blog/2017/07/28/jfl35-seinfeld-and-elmaleh-face-off-at-bell-centre/
5. Gad Elmaleh → Minions: And Elmaleh, the French voice of Gru, posed with the Minions at their 2022 Paris premiere.
   Photo by Universal Pictures France, via Mulderville, Fair use (commentary): https://mulderville.net/en/events/1787/minions-the-rise-of-gru-discover-the-official-photos-of-the-paris-premiere

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#vladimirlenin #minions #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
